name: skills-engineering
description: Writes and audits Claude skills wherever they live, from personal, project and plugin folders to Claude accounts, the Skills API and URLs: authoring-skills researches your goal, your setup and the skill's domain in current official sources, gets your approval on a versioned design and a plan, then builds the skill and self-reviews it with the plugin's skill checks, and auditing-skills runs the same checks, then nine specialized reviewer agents in parallel, each returning quoted file-and-line evidence, severity, an exact fix and a verdict.
